parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The new alias of the module. The alias can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The alias must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Desc
parameters.description: The new description of the module. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description: The name of the OTA module.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the OTA module belongs.
